NET-001.title: Unexpected SSH Exposure
known: HTTP is an expected service for WEB-02.
HTTPS is an expected service for WEB-02.
The asset is owned by Web Operations.
The asset is classified as Medium criticality.
evidence_gaps: Whether SSH is authorised for administration.
Whether the host is reachable from external networks.
Whether the discovered SSH service matches the approved baseline.

timeline.event: Network discovery identifies TCP/22, TCP/80 and TCP/443.
TCP/22 is compared with the documented service baseline and is not listed.
Web Operations states that administrators normally use SSH for maintenance.
Verification is required before the exposure can be closed as expected.

assessment_guidance.Expected: Select only if evidence establishes that SSH is authorised and appropriate for this asset.
assessment_guidance.Requires Investigation: Appropriate when SSH is unexplained but more evidence is available or expected.
assessment_guidance.Security Concern: Appropriate when evidence establishes an unnecessary or materially risky exposure.
assessment_guidance.Insufficient Evidence: Appropriate when the available evidence cannot support a defensible classification.

NET-002.title: Unknown Asset With Exposed Services
known: The host responded to network discovery.
evidence_gaps: Whether the host is externally reachable.

timeline.event: Network discovery identifies an otherwise unknown host.
TCP/22 and TCP/8080 are observed as listening services.
No owner, business purpose or approved service baseline is available.
Ownership and authorisation must be established before closure.

assessment_guidance.Expected: Do not select without establishing ownership and authorised purpose.
assessment_guidance.Requires Investigation: Appropriate because the asset and services require validation.
assessment_guidance.Security Concern: Requires additional evidence demonstrating a security impact or unauthorised exposure.
assessment_guidance.Insufficient Evidence: Defensible if the analyst explains that ownership, purpose and exposure context are unavailable.
